Gets App Store review status. - IOS only. `release_management_review_status` is the review's status in Bitrise. `app_store_review_status` is the state App Store Connect reports for the review submission, or for the version's item once the submission is complete. When an approved version is rejected or resubmitted with another build in App Store Connect, `release_management_review_status` reads `cancelled` while `app_store_review_status` can still read `APPROVED`, as App Store Connect keeps the completed submission's item approved.
